federation.serviceSdl:
type Mutation {
  """Publish a new sensor reading"""
  publishReading(input: SenMLRecordInput!): SenMLRecord
}

type Query {
  """Get historical readings for a sensor"""
  getSensorHistory(limit: Int = 10, sensorId: ID!): [SenMLRecord!]

  """Get latest reading for a sensor"""
  getSensorReading(sensorId: ID!): SenMLRecord

  """List all available sensors"""
  listSensors: [Sensor!]
}

"""RFC 8428 SenML Record"""
type SenMLRecord {
  """Sensor name (required)"""
  n: String!

  """Sum value for cumulative measurements"""
  s: Float

  """Time in seconds since Unix epoch"""
  t: Float

  """Unit (e.g., Cel, %RH, hPa)"""
  u: String

  """Numeric value"""
  v: Float

  """Boolean value"""
  vb: Boolean

  """String value"""
  vs: String
}

"""Input for publishing sensor readings"""
input SenMLRecordInput {
  n: String!
  u: String
  v: Float
  vb: Boolean
  vs: String
}

"""Sensor metadata"""
type Sensor {
  """Sensor ID"""
  id: String!

  """Most recent reading from this sensor"""
  lastReading: SenMLRecord

  """Sensor name"""
  name: String!

  """Default unit"""
  unit: String
}
